Sam (CSM): Heads-up: MeridianAI dedicated pool bring-up. Need final quota, autoscale envelope, and a 30m load test to validate p95 and cost. Proposed slot: Thu 14:00 UTC (30m). Can team confirm?

Hector (Eng Infra): I can make it. I'll allocate a reserved pool: 3 H100 + 3 A100. Autoscale: enable with soft cap 9 nodes, hard cap 12 nodes only if we explicitly uncap. Will enable KV priming as suggested.
Lena - MeridianAI: OK from our side. A couple asks: 1) We want a rehearsal-only stricter p95 threshold (1.0s) to trigger fallback. 2) Please share estimated spend for the 30m test. 3) Can QA get sample responses?
Priya (Solutions Eng): We can set rehearsal threshold to 1.0s. Cost rough calc: ~$0.09 per 1k tokens at this profile; will refine after smoke. We'll capture sample outputs and upload to a shared folder.
Hector (Eng Infra): Priming task I'll run 12:45 UTC for 10m: `warmup --file meridian-top150.json --concurrency 6 --duration 600`. Pool id will be posted here when ready.
Sam (CSM): Runbook items: reserved pool allocated (Hector), autoscale profile set (Hector), k6 script + env (Priya), fallback CLI + contacts (Priya + Sam), customer probe (Lena). Target Friday EOD to lock.
Lena - MeridianAI: We'll run a connectivity probe Thu 13:50 UTC for 10m. Also provide phone numbers for on-call.
deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "MeridianAI Dedicated Bring-Up" Thu 1745560800 14:00 UTC. Reminder 20m before. Organizer: Sam (CSM).
Priya (Solutions Eng): Fallback CLI for rehearsal: `redwood route set --team meridian --target hosted-main --reason "rehearsal fallback"`. I'll also add a two-step confirm flag so it's not accidental.
Hector (Eng Infra): Pool provisioned: pool-8342. Autoscale snapshot posted: https://dash.redwood/pools/pool-8342/snapshot.
Sam (CSM): Great — I'll prepare a one-pager for the renewal meeting showing expected p95 and estimated cost delta. Any other asks? :thumbsup:
Lena - MeridianAI: All good. Thanks everyone, we'll see you Thu.
Priya (Solutions Eng): k6 + prompts uploaded: https://drive.redwood/meridian/rehearsal. Also enabling log export during soak for deeper QA.
Sam (CSM): Locking schedule: Thu 14:00 UTC, pre-probe 13:50. Owners confirmed. Closing thread unless objections.
